newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp, Big Rivers sign agreement.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp, Big Rivers sign agreement.

text.p: U.S. western utility PacifiCorp said it had signed an "omnibus agreement" with Big Rivers Electric Corp after eight months of negotiating to establish an alliance between the two of them.

PacifiCorp of Portland, Oregon said the agreement replaces the letter of intent it had signed with Big Rivers earlier in the year under which it would pay Big Rivers $30.1 million to operate its plants for 25 years.
Although Big Rivers would still own the 10 Kentucky coal-fired plants, PacifiCorp would sell the 1,740 megawatts of power generated from them.
PacifiCorp said the agreement detailed how the alliance would work as well as the operating pacts that they had negotiated.
"This agreement will lead to a strategic alliance that promises more stable rates and increased economic development opportunites for western Kentucky," it said.

"We are engaged in the final phase of this process -- completing other agreements with PacifiCorp , seeking the necessary state and federal regulatory approvals as well as other necessary approvals and ensuring that our fuel costs are at market prices," it cited Big Rivers as saying.
